common.tagline: Location + requirements research assistance across multiple sources.

form.title: What are you looking for, and where?
form.subtitle: Describe the place and your requirements. A run checks several sources and builds a dossier with quoted evidence.
form.submitNote: A run checks several sources and stops after {minutes} minutes. You can close this tab — the dossier is saved to your history.

postal.label: Postal / ZIP
postal.hint: Narrows a large city down to one delivery area.

geo.denied: Location permission was denied. Type a location instead.
geo.unavailable: Could not get your location. Type one instead.
geo.insecure: Location needs a secure (https or localhost) context.
geo.lookupFailed: Could not look up that location. Type one instead.
geo.coarse: Your browser could only place you very roughly. Type your city or postal code instead.

searchLanguage.label: Search language
searchLanguage.hint: The language sources are searched in — not the language of this page.

timeout.label: Timeout
timeout.hint: How long a run may take before it returns whatever it has.

request.label: Anything specific?
request.description: Add the details a menu or listing would have to mention, or start from an example.
request.placeholder: e.g. gluten-free brunch with a dedicated fryer

gfBrunch.title: Gluten-free brunch with a dedicated fryer

moldVerdun.title: Basement apartment with no mould history

chips.label: What has to be true?
chips.description: Each requirement adds its own checks, and the dossier reports on it separately.
chips.hint: Pick at least one, or describe what you need below.

solari.label: Solari API key
solari.banner: Key stays in this browser tab. Don't use this pattern on a public server.

errors.nothingToSearch: Add a request or pick at least one requirement.
errors.submitFailed: Could not start the run. Try again.

run.title: Research run
run.dossierUnavailable: The dossier could not be loaded. The activity log below still shows what the run did.

status.doneNote: Every source that answered is in the dossier below.
status.partialNote: Stopped at the time limit — these are the results so far.
status.errorNote: The run did not finish. Some results may be missing.
status.queuedNote: Waiting for a worker to pick this up.

degradedLlm.title: No Anthropic API key.
degradedLlm.body: Planning and extraction ran on a stub, so these results are low quality and largely canned. Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to your .env and run the search again.

degradedSolari.title: Solari browser unavailable.
degradedSolari.body: A Solari API key is set, but the cloud browser could not start — this run used recorded sample data. See the event log for the reason.

solariSkippedNoLlm.title: Live browsing skipped.
solariSkippedNoLlm.body: A Solari key is set, but no working Anthropic key was available — a live browser could only have run canned queries, so this run used recorded sample data and spent no Solari usage. Add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to your .env and run the search again.

dossier.title: Dossier
dossier.summary: {count} places, ranked by the evidence found for your requirements.

sampleData.title: This dossier contains sample data.
sampleData.body: The following sources returned recorded sample data instead of a live result: {sources}.

dossier.notSearched: Not searched: {sources}. These sources are not implemented yet, so they ran but contributed nothing.

consensus.conflictedNote: Sources disagree about this place — read the excerpts before deciding.

dossier.replayNone: No replay available on this plan.

replay.empty: Nothing was recorded for this source.
replay.tooLarge: Recording was too large to store.
replay.unavailable: No replay available for this source.

history.title: Your runs
history.description: Every dossier you have started, newest first.
history.notRecordedTitle: This run predates provenance tracking — whether it used sample or live data was not recorded.

errors.loadFailed: Could not load this page. Try again.
